# Marlow Quist

The map. One-liners carry the numbers; route on those, not on filenames.

## The wiki

- [Crumb and hydration](wiki/crumb-and-hydration.md) — an open crumb is fermentation, not water; they cap a beginner at 68 % and only go past 75 % on flour above 13 % protein.
- [Oven management](wiki/oven-management.md) — 30 minutes of steam-equivalent under a lid, then 25 minutes dry at 230 °C; they pull at 98 °C and blame a pale crust on the second half, never the first.
- [Teaching a first bake](wiki/teaching-a-first-bake.md) — one variable per bake, four bakes before anything is judged; they refuse to give a recipe without a timetable attached.

## Known gaps

- **Commercial production.** Everything here is one to four loaves in a home oven. Deck ovens, retarder loads and wholesale timing are not covered.
- **Rye and enriched doughs.** They work in lean wheat; rye above 20 % and anything with butter or egg in it is outside this corpus.
- **Milling and grain sourcing.** They talk about protein percentages constantly and about where flour comes from almost never.
- **Their commercial arrangements.** Who they teach for, what they charge, what they endorse — none of it is in this material.
